which node npm qpdf pdftk gs 2>&1; pip download reportlab --no-deps -d /tmp/rl 2>&1 | tail -1

python3 make_cover.py && python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader
r = PdfReader('cover.pdf')
print('cover pages:', len(r.pages))
print('cover text:', repr(r.pages[0].extract_text()))
"

python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

reader = PdfReader('cover.pdf')
report = PdfReader('report.pdf')

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(reader.pages[0])          # cover page first
for page in report.pages:                 # then original report content
    writer.add_page(page)

with open('report.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    writer.write(f)

# Verify the final document
final = PdfReader('report.pdf')
print('Final page count:', len(final.pages))
for i, page in enumerate(final.pages):
    text = (page.extract_text() or '').strip().replace('\n', ' | ')
    print(f'Page {i+1}: {text}')
"
rm -f cover.pdf make_cover.py && file report.pdf && ls -la report.pdf
